bookings_idempotency_active_uidx.name: bookings_idempotency_active_uidx
bookings_idempotency_active_uidx.where: idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('confirmed', 'arrived', 'in_progress')

bookings_during_half_open.name: bookings_during_half_open
bookings_during_half_open.value: lower_inc(during) AND NOT upper_inc(during) AND NOT isempty(during) AND NOT lower_inf(during) AND NOT upper_inf(during)

bookings_web_has_consent.name: bookings_web_has_consent
bookings_web_has_consent.value: source <> 'web' OR consent_id IS NOT NULL

bookings_web_has_idempotency.name: bookings_web_has_idempotency
bookings_web_has_idempotency.value: source <> 'web' OR idempotency_key IS NOT NULL

bookings_deleted_inactive.name: bookings_deleted_inactive
bookings_deleted_inactive.value: deleted_at IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('confirmed', 'arrived', 'in_progress')

overrides_valid.name: overrides_valid
overrides_valid.value: is_closed OR (open_min IS NOT NULL AND close_min IS NOT NULL AND open_min < close_min)

business_hours_valid.name: business_hours_valid
business_hours_valid.value: is_closed OR (open_min IS NOT NULL AND close_min IS NOT NULL AND open_min < close_min)

consents_pii_purge_idx.name: consents_pii_purge_idx
consents_pii_purge_idx.where: ip_hash IS NOT NULL OR user_agent IS NOT NULL

customers_phone_e164_uidx.name: customers_phone_e164_uidx
customers_phone_e164_uidx.where: phone_e164 IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND merged_into_customer_id IS NULL

customers_name_len.name: customers_name_len
customers_name_len.value: name IS NULL OR char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 50

customers_name_present.name: customers_name_present
customers_name_present.value: anonymized_at IS NOT NULL OR name IS NOT NULL

customers_anonymized_clean.name: customers_anonymized_clean
customers_anonymized_clean.value: anonymized_at IS NULL OR (name IS NULL AND name_kana IS NULL AND phone_e164 IS NULL AND phone_display IS NULL AND line_user_id IS NULL AND instagram_user_id IS NULL AND instagram_handle IS NULL)

karte_photos_dims.name: karte_photos_dims
karte_photos_dims.value: width BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND height BETWEEN 1 AND 4096

menus_price_student_range.name: menus_price_student_range
menus_price_student_range.value: price_student_jpy IS NULL OR price_student_jpy BETWEEN 0 AND price_jpy

time_blocks_during_half_open.name: time_blocks_during_half_open
time_blocks_during_half_open.value: lower_inc(during) AND NOT upper_inc(during) AND NOT isempty(during) AND NOT lower_inf(during) AND NOT upper_inf(during)
